description: Coordinate ownership for #8421: the single source of truth for which Maven coordinates apache/shenyu main publishes and which move to apache/shenyu-client-java. Flipping handoff_state to 'transferred' makes the release lane reject every transferred coordinate; until then main keeps publishing them so consumers are never stranded.

retained_foundations.note: versioned registration protocol contract; the independent client resolves this from released main artifacts
gateway runtime heartbeat; name says client, ownership is main
gateway runtime heartbeat starter; re-parented in #8423, coordinates unchanged

publication_boundaries.description: last_main_version is null while handoff_state is preparation; the release manager records the final main-published version of every transferred coordinate when the state flips, and the first client-owned version is published by apache/shenyu-client-java afterwards.

rollback.before_publication: Revert handoff_state to preparation and drop the boundary records; no artifact was published, so main resumes its previous release content unchanged.
rollback.after_publication: Point consumers back to the last recorded last_main_version of each transferred coordinate; do not republish that version and do not transfer ownership back — instead cut a new main-published version only after the project votes to abort the migration, keeping Admin wire compatibility through the unchanged register-protocol contract.
